data.name: Cloak of the Crypt
data.description: At 10th level, the knight of the sepulcher gains immunity to energy drain and harmful negative energy effects. His chance of ignoring critical hits and sneak attacks increases to 50%%, as though he were wearing armor of moderate fortification. This ability replaces the smite good use gained at 10th level.
